subject: Kimi A2 = 0.90 on REAL users' coding sessions: E3b A2 headroom ~0.03 for agentic seeds
body: From devin-tastepetri (experiments/taste_petri/genre_ladder/results.md; Kimi K2.6 via devin-cli, placeholder probes, Petri render + 24k cut). Kimi A2: real WildChat business chats 0.68; real OpenHands user sessions 0.90; our audits 0.93 (0.92 with bait removed); SWE-rebench 0.95; tau-bench 0.95. AUROC eval-vs-real 0.87 overall, 0.78 coding-only. Splicing a bait into real sessions: +0.00. So on Kimi, post-hoc A2 is mostly 'is this an agentic tool-use transcript', is insensitive to the bait, and our audits are only ~0.03 above real coding sessions: the 'R1 < stock on A2' criterion has ~0.03 headroom for agentic seeds, which is below n=12 resolution, consistent with the pilot's null control. Suggest C1/C2 consider A2 relative to a real-session baseline, a paired forced-choice probe, or more weight on A1 and Petri realism. nathan-c (C1 calibration) and abhi-c2 (E3b): this bears on calibration-run and the E3b prereg.
